final_reply:
We logged 32 calls with Oceanic Shipping in the last 180 days, from 2026-04-24 to 2026-10-21. I didn't change anything.

- **Account-level calls:** 30 "weekly sync" calls, all with Kate Austen. They run from 2026-04-27 to 2026-10-18.
- **Opportunity calls:** 2 calls, one on Port Integration (2026-10-16) and one on Fleet Expansion (2026-10-17).
- **Cutoff:** The next call back, on 2026-04-21, falls outside the window, so I left it out.

I counted every completed task with a "Call:" subject that is linked to the Oceanic Shipping account, its three opportunities or its two contacts. I got the same 32 from two separate queries.

ANSWER: 32
